paras.text: Everyone has observed the effect of gravity as it causes objects to fall downward. In the absence of air resistance, it is found that all bodies at the same location above the earth fall vertically with the same acceleration. Furthermore, if the distance of the fall is small compared to the radius of the earth, the acceleration can be considered constant throughout its fall. The motion, in which air resistance is neglected and the acceleration is nearly constant, is known as free-fall.
paras.urdu: ہر شخص نے کشش ثقل کا اثر دیکھا ہے کہ یہ چیزوں کو نیچے گراتی ہے۔ ہوا کی مزاحمت نہ ہو تو زمین کے اوپر ایک ہی مقام پر تمام جسم یکساں تعجیل سے عمودی طور پر گرتے ہیں۔ اگر گرنے کا فاصلہ زمین کے رداس کے مقابل چھوٹا ہو تو پوری گراوٹ میں تعجیل مستقل سمجھی جا سکتی ہے۔ وہ حرکت جس میں ہوا کی مزاحمت نظر انداز اور تعجیل تقریباً مستقل ہو، آزاد سقوط کہلاتی ہے۔

numericals.name: COMMERCIAL AIRCRAFT RUNWAY LENGTH
numericals.statement: A Boeing 777 aircraft takes off at 295 km/h after accelerating from rest at 2.80 m/s². What is the minimum runway length required?
numericals.given:
initial velocity vᵢ = 0 km/h = 0 m/s
final velocity v𝒇 = 295 km/h = 81.9 m/s
acceleration = 2.80 m/s²
numericals.solution:
The units came out correctly as for displacement (meters) but we have to correct the number and express in three significant figures.

A runway needs to be longer than 1.2 km as this was calculated minimum length to give a margin of safety. Most commercial airport runways are between 2 km and 4 km long.

activities.name: BRAKING CAR
activities.procedure: On Motorway M1, a car is moving at speed limit of 120 km/h. By applying brakes the car comes to rest after covering a distance of 30 m. What is the deceleration of the car?
activities.urdu: M1 موٹر وے پر گاڑی رفتار کی حد 120 km/h پر چل رہی ہے۔ بریک لگانے سے گاڑی 30 m فاصلہ طے کر کے رک جاتی ہے۔ گاڑی کی رفتار میں کمی کی تعجیل کیا ہے؟
activities.pashto: پر M1 موټروې یو موټر د چټکتیا په حد، 120 km/h، روان دی. د بریک په وهلو موټر د 30 m واټن تر وهلو وروسته درېږي. د موټر د ورو کېدو تعجیل څومره دی؟
